title: Hepatoprotective effects of linalool against liver ischemia-reperfusion: the role of Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 and TLR4/RAGE/NFkappaB pathways.
authors: Younis, N S; Abdelnaby, R M; Mohamed, M E
journal: European review for medical and pharmacological sciences
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芳樟醇对肝脏缺血再灌注损伤的保护作用及Nrf2/TLR4等信号通路，仅含少量分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Hepatic ischemia-reperfusion (H I/R) injury arises due to a temporary obstruction followed by the re-establishment of blood supply to the liver. Linalool (LIN), a main volatile constituent of essential oils in numerous aromatic plant species, exhibited various medicinal and pharmacological actions. This study investigated the protective effect of LIN on the status of H I/R, with the study of the possible mechanisms. In addition, linalool's antagonistic effects were tested against several metabolic targets using in silico molecular docking technique. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Wistar rats were allocated into five groups. Sham and LIN + Sham groups in which animals were administered either vehicle (1% CMC) or LIN (200 mg/kg/day) orally for two weeks. H I/R group in which rats were administered 1% CMC for two weeks and then experienced hepatic ischemia for 60 min followed by 6 hours of reperfusion. LIN 100 + H I/R and LIN 200 + H I/R groups in which rats were pretreated with LIN (100, 200 mg/kg/day) respectively for two weeks, then subjected to H I/R. RESULTS: H I/R-induced injury resulted in impaired liver function and activated Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 and HMGB1/TLR4/RAGE/NFsmall ka, CyrillicB pathways with subsequent oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis. LIN pretreatment alleviated I/R-induced impairment in liver function, promoted Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1, and mitigated the HMGB1/TLR4/RAGE/NFsmall ka, CyrillicB pathway. LIN pre-administration deterred adhesion molecule, neutrophils infiltration, RAGE, IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and apoptosis. CONCLUSIONS: LIN demonstrated hepato-protective effects against H I/R via instigation Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 and mitigating the HMGB1/TLR4/RAGE/NFsmall ka, CyrillicB pathways with subsequent deterring oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：肝脏缺血再灌注（H I/R）损伤源于肝脏血供的暂时性阻塞后血流恢复。芳樟醇（LIN）是多种芳香植物精油中的主要挥发性成分，具有多种药用和药理作用。本研究探讨了LIN对H I/R状态下的保护作用，并研究了可能的机制。此外，利用计算机分子对接技术测试了芳樟醇对多个代谢靶点的拮抗作用。材料与方法：将Wistar大鼠分为五组。Sham组和LIN + Sham组，动物分别口服给予载体（1% CMC）或LIN（200 mg/kg/天）两周。H I/R组，大鼠给予1% CMC两周，然后经历肝脏缺血60分钟，随后再灌注6小时。LIN 100 + H I/R组和LIN 200 + H I/R组，大鼠分别用LIN（100、200 mg/kg/天）预处理两周，然后进行H I/R。结果：H I/R诱导的损伤导致肝功能受损，并激活Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1和HMGB1/TLR4/RAGE/NF-κB通路，随后引发氧化应激、炎症和凋亡。LIN预处理减轻了I/R诱导的肝功能损伤，促进了Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1通路，并缓解了HMGB1/TLR4/RAGE/NF-κB通路。LIN预给药抑制了粘附分子、中性粒细胞浸润、RAGE、IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α和凋亡。结论：LIN通过激活Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1通路并缓解HMGB1/TLR4/RAGE/NF-κB通路，从而抑制氧化应激、炎症和凋亡，对H I/R表现出肝脏保护作用。
